# Chapter 7: Nancy

Bob met Nancy in a grocery store.

He was in Michigan for work, visiting his company's headquarters, when he found himself standing near the egg case — of all places — next to a woman who turned to him and remarked on the prices. It was a time of high inflation, and eggs had nearly doubled. They talked for a few minutes about the economy, the strangeness of prices that changed weekly, the small irritations of ordinary life.
